# LokalScout — Hyperlocal Commercial Feasibility & Shop Location Intelligence

> LokalScout (`https://lokalscout.in`) is an AI-powered commercial location feasibility platform for brick-and-mortar retail founders, doctors, clinic owners, salon founders, and franchisees in India. It audits footfall catchments, competitor saturation, customer complaints, commercial rental benchmarks, and unit-economics break-even math before a business signs a 3-year commercial rental agreement.

## Overview & Core Capabilities

- **Pedestrian Footfall & Walking Catchments**: Evaluates real 5-minute (~380m) and 10-minute (~780m) walking reach around tech parks, metro stations, colleges, and residential societies, identifying walking barriers like flyovers and divided expressways.
- **Competitor Saturation & Sentiment Mining**: Counts direct competitors within 2 km and 5 km, computes an overall saturation score (0–100), and synthesizes recurrent customer complaints (e.g. parking friction, slow service, pricing).
- **Indicative Commercial Rent Benchmarks**: Aggregates neighbourhood market averages for main-road frontage vs. inner-lane spaces. *Note: Per-sq.ft commercial rents are indicative approximate neighbourhood benchmarks; actual shop rent depends on frontage, floor level, and landlord negotiation.*
- **Dynamic Break-Even Modeling**: Mathematical sensitivity simulator calculating required daily customers and monthly turnover needed to cover rent, staff payroll, utilities, and COGS.
- **Turnkey Fit-Out Capex Estimators**: Turnkey interior budgeting (civil, electrical, HVAC, furniture, branding) tailored to Indian commercial spaces.
- **Executive PDF Dossier**: Downloadable bank-loan and franchise-ready PDF report for ₹799.

## Covered Indian Metros & Micro-Markets

- **Hyderabad**: Madhapur (Ayyappa Society, Kavuri Hills, 100ft Road), Gachibowli (Financial District, Nanakramguda), Jubilee Hills (Road No 36, Road No 45), Banjara Hills (Road No 12), Kondapur.
- **Bengaluru**: Indiranagar (100ft Road, 12th Main), Koramangala (4th & 5th Block), HSR Layout (Sector 1), Whitefield (ITPL Main Road).
- **Mumbai**: Bandra West (Pali Hill, Linking Road), Andheri West (Lokhandwala Complex), Powai (Hiranandani Gardens).
- **Pune**: Baner High Street, Koregaon Park North Main Road.
- **Delhi-NCR**: DLF Cyber City Gurgaon, Cyber Hub, Connaught Place, Hauz Khas.

## Company & Ecosystem

LokalScout is part of the **GrowLokal** ecosystem (`https://growlokal.in`), helping Indian local businesses launch, optimize Google Maps 3-Packs, and run customer WhatsApp loyalty funnels.
